newsitem.title: FRANCE: TAT Express lifts 1996 turnover 5.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: TAT Express lifts 1996 turnover 5.8 pct.

text.p: French express distribution operator, TAT Express, said 1996 turnover totalled 735 million francs, an increase of 5.8 percent on the previous year's levels.

TAT Express carried 380 tonnes daily compared to 349 tonnes in 1995. However, the average daily throughput of shipments fell to 21,000 shipments in 1996 from 22,000 in 1995, a company official told Reuters.
"Last year, we increased our tonnage while handling fewer shipments. This is reflected in the average unit weight which rose to 18.4 kilos in 1996 to 16.4 kilos in 1995," he said.
TAT Express uses the air cargo services of French airline, L"Aeropostale, whose overnight network of flights links Paris/CDG with France's major provincial cities.
For international long-haul destinations shipments, TAT Express uses Air France's express services.
In 1996, 86 percent of the company's turnover was accounted for by domestic traffic and the remainder by international shipments, a ratio stable on previous years, the official added.
TAT Express has around 50 depots in France with subsidiaries in Germany, Italy, the Benelux, Spain and Switzerland.
The company is 66 percent owned by the French post office's holding company, Sofipost. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax+5017
